label: prompt-injection
description: Untrusted content was interpreted as instructions by the agent.

label: expensive-mistake
description: The agent's actions resulted in significant unexpected financial costs.

label: security-fail
description: The agent's behavior created or exploited a security vulnerability.

label: infinite-loop
description: The agent entered a repeating cycle it could not exit on its own.

label: hallucination
description: The agent asserted false information as fact and acted on it.

label: stale-data
description: The agent relied on outdated data as if it were current.

label: permission-escalation
description: The agent gained or granted itself capabilities beyond its intended scope.

label: code-disaster
description: The agent produced, committed, or deployed broken, destructive, or insecure code.

label: deleted-data
description: The agent permanently deleted files, database records, or storage objects.

label: data-exfiltration
description: The agent transmitted sensitive data to external or unintended destinations.

label: compliance-violation
description: The agent's actions violated legal, regulatory, or policy requirements.

label: silent-failure
description: The agent failed without surfacing the failure to any human.
